packageRules.description: Test against the latest Pi without waiting out the release-age gate. Keep the supported Pi floor when newer releases fit the devDependency range.

Pi's docs/packages.md has a package declare the packages Pi provides as peerDependencies at "*", so it loads in whichever Pi hosts it. Renovate leaves those peers alone; the devDependencies carry the Pi the package is built against.

Pinned to the version pi ships. Pi's extension loader aliases typebox to its own bundled copy, so our declaration only types what pi executes and must match it. It moves when pi moves, not on Renovate's schedule; the typebox pin test reports when that happens.

mise lock writes these sidecars for mise.renovate.lock, and the mise manager regenerates them when it bumps Renovate. The npm manager would otherwise bump the sidecar's package.json on its own, out of step with its lock and digest.

@types/node describes the runtime, so it tracks the Node these packages run on rather than the newest DefinitelyTyped release. Types from a later major describe APIs that are not there and hide ones that were removed, and tsc believes them either way. It follows the engines floor in package.json, not the toolchain in mise.toml, which may run newer; raise the ceiling when the floor moves.

biome.json's $schema names the exact Biome release, kept current by customManagers:biomeVersions, so Biome is pinned exactly as its install guide does (npm i -E) and the package, the schema, and any mise pin move in one PR. Last, so it overrides the per-manager groups.
